note: Factual stats only, each from an official athletics site. No projections. Weber State was off Nov 7, so its stat is from Oct 31.

stats.name: BYU
stats.label: Receiving yards by Legend Glasker
stats.line: Legend Glasker led BYU with 118 receiving yards, including a 75-yard touchdown catch from Bear Bachmeier, in the 28-20 loss at Utah. Walker Lyons added 97 yards on seven catches. BYU is 7-2 overall and 4-2 in Big 12 play.
stats.game: Utah 28, BYU 20 — Sat Nov 7, Salt Lake City

stats.name: Utah
stats.label: Interceptions of Bear Bachmeier
stats.line: Utah intercepted Bear Bachmeier four times, its most in a game since Oct. 1, 2022 and the most Bachmeier has thrown in his career. Trey Reynolds ended a BYU drive in the red zone with 4:39 left, and Nate Ritchie intercepted BYU's last pass in the closing seconds of the 28-20 win. Utah is 9-0 overall and 6-0 in Big 12 play with a nation's-best 15 straight wins.
stats.game: Utah 28, BYU 20 — Sat Nov 7, Salt Lake City

stats.name: Utah State
stats.label: Rushing yards allowed to Fresno State
stats.line: Utah State held Fresno State to 16 rushing yards, the fewest the Aggies have allowed since 12 against San Jose State in 2021, and recorded 10 tackles for loss in the 17-10 win. Ronnie Mageo had a career-high 3.5 of them. Utah State is 4-5 overall and 3-2 in Pac-12 play.
stats.game: Utah State 17, Fresno State 10 — Sat Nov 7, Logan

stats.name: Weber State
stats.label: Total yards by Nate Dahle
stats.line: Freshman quarterback Nate Dahle threw for 309 yards and three touchdowns and ran for 79 yards and another score, totaling 388 yards of offense in Weber State's 38-14 win over UC Davis. Weber State was off last week and is 6-4 overall and 5-2 in Big Sky play.
stats.game: Weber State 38, UC Davis 14 — Sat Oct 31, Ogden

stats.name: Southern Utah
stats.label: Rushing yards by Floyd Chalk this season
stats.line: Floyd Chalk ran for 66 yards in the 31-24 win over Northern Colorado, pushing his season total to 1,289 yards, past Joe Dupaix (1,246 in 1996) for eighth on Southern Utah's single-season list. Southern Utah is 4-6 overall and 3-4 in Big Sky play.
stats.game: Southern Utah 31, Northern Colorado 24 — Sat Nov 7, Cedar City

stats.name: Utah Tech
stats.label: Total yards allowed to UC Davis
stats.line: Utah Tech's defense limited UC Davis to 267 total yards, with two sacks and four tackles for loss, and Will Alovao returned his first career interception to the UC Davis 15 to set up the opening touchdown in the 24-17 loss. Utah Tech is 1-9 overall and 1-6 in Big Sky play.
stats.game: UC Davis 24, Utah Tech 17 — Sat Nov 7, Davis, Calif.
